faq.a: Aalimah is written عالمة in Arabic and عالمہ in Urdu, and आलिमा in Devanagari.

faq.a: The root of Aalimah is ع-ل-م (ʿ-l-m).

faq.a: Yes. Aalimah and Aalima are transliterations of the same Arabic ʿĀlimah (عالمة), meaning 'female scholar'.
